subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**popularity**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**popularity**" means the state or condition of being liked, admired, or supported by many people. (लोकप्रियता)
 
• In the context of the passage, talking about topics that interest your listeners helps you gain a reputation for being well-liked and engaging, hence increasing your** popularity.**
 
• The other options: "**irrationality**", "**capacity**", and "**audacity**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Therein lies the secret of your popularity__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Irrationality (अकर्तव्यता)**: means the quality of being illogical or unreasonable.
 
• **Capacity (क्षमता)**: means the ability or power to do something.
 
• **Audacity (धृष्टता)**: means the willingness to take bold risks or show impudent behavior.
